featurize.pooling: native (wav2vec2 has no pooler; adapter masked_mean)

feature_cache_reuse_verified.why_safe: run_head_quality.audio_task carves train/cal/test from the SAME sorted path list with the SAME bc.make_splits(seed=0), so the cached rows are the same states; the reuse is only accepted after the per-split emotion-label counts agree.

protocol.one_question_per_batch_justification: JevXForDecision.forward shares one question across the state batch, so a batch is a set of states asking the SAME question; the option count is therefore uniform and no padded option column is produced. --phase shared-state shows the m-question call agrees with the per-question calls to float32 re-association with identical argmax, so this protocol is the same computation as the genuine multi-question forward.
protocol.head_init: every arm starts from bitwise-identical head weights (torch.manual_seed(1234) before the wrapper is built)
protocol.head_hidden_deviation: DEVIATION: the JevX head runs at width 256 instead of the 768 feature width, because one (arm, seed) cell at the full width costs ~270 s on a 4-core box shared with other agents and the full grid did not fit this wave's wall-clock budget. The width is IDENTICAL across all four JevX arms here, so the within-dataset comparison is unaffected; the audio head at full width is NOT established here.
